## Summary

What does this pull request change?

## Motivation

Why is this change needed? Link the relevant issue or describe the problem.

## Implementation details

Summarize the approach and any important compatibility, behavior, or migration details.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Testing performed

List the exact checks or tests run and their results. Note any checks you could not run.

## Screenshots or recordings

For visible UI or desktop behavior changes, attach before/after screenshots or a short recording when useful. Remove personal or sensitive information first.

## Model evaluation (model-related changes)

For model-related changes, include the architecture/version, dataset source and license/permissions, class mapping, training configuration, validation split and metrics, test examples, checkpoint format, file size/SHA-256 if available, compatibility evidence, and known limitations. Do not attach large `.pt` files unless maintainers have agreed on an appropriate submission method. A proposal does not itself publish or integrate a model.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests and checks, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I have updated related documentation.
- [ ] I have considered compatibility with the supported Windows application and Python worker.
- [ ] I have not included secrets, unlicensed third-party material, or unintended large/generated files.
- [ ] For model-related changes, I have included evaluation, rights, compatibility, and limitation information above.
